summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by The Bank of Nova Scotia, a Canadian bank, to furnish certifications required under Canadian securities legislation (Form 52-109F2) for its interim period ended April 30, 2026. It includes certifications by the CEO and CFO regarding the interim financial report and MD&A, affirming no material misstatements and responsibility for disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting. The filing does not reference any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. It is a routine periodic certification filing. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K corresponds to a US Form 10-Q or annual certification requirement. No deal terms are present.
